paragraphs.text: BACKGROUND:  The Parties require reimbursable support to complete Range 14 surface danger zone maintenance from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.
REFERENCES/AUTHORITIES:  Applicable support agreements and funding authorities of each Party.
AUTHORITIES:  Each Party will cite its own legal authority to transfer funds for the services described herein.
PURPOSE:  Establish terms for reimbursable maintenance support services during the Range 14 closure.
RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE PARTIES:  The supporting Party will provide labor and materials; the receiving Party will reimburse documented costs.
PERSONNEL:  Each Party retains administrative control of its assigned personnel.
GENERAL PROVISIONS:  This MOA may be modified only by written agreement of the Parties.
